7. Doc Studio

7.1 What is the Doc Studio?

The Doc Studio is the central tool for creating contracts, invoices, and letters. It generates professional Word (DOCX) and PDF documents based on templates with variable content.

Features at a glance:

  • Template-based DOCX and PDF generation
  • Inline editor with Word-like preview
  • Drag and drop block editing
  • Variable system for dynamic content
  • Undo function (up to 3 steps)
  • Generation log with download
  • Invoice management

7.3 Studio / Editor

The editor is divided into two areas:

Left column:

  • Template: Selection of the document template (e.g., Framework Agreement)
  • Reference: Unique identifier for the document (e.g., ANF-2026-0042)
  • Format: DOCX, PDF, or both
  • Variables: All placeholders of the template with input fields
  • Content Blocks: All blocks of the template, movable via drag and drop

Right side:

  • Undo button: Reverses the last change (up to 3 steps)
  • Editor / Preview toggle: Switch between editor and pure preview
  • Document canvas: Word-like page view

7.4 Filling in Variables

Variables are placeholders in the document recognizable by curly braces: {an_firma}, {stundensatz} etc.

  1. Select template - variables appear automatically on the left
  2. Enter value in the input field
  3. Preview updates automatically
  4. Click on the blue variable key to copy it

7.5 Editing Blocks

Double-click on a block in the document opens it for editing:

  1. Double-click on block - textarea opens
  2. Adjust text - variables can be typed directly
  3. Click variable chips below the textarea to insert
  4. Save - change is immediately saved to the database
  5. Cancel - discards the change

Note: Saved changes affect the template.

7.6 Moving Blocks

In editor mode, blocks can be moved via drag and drop:

  • Drop zones appear between blocks
  • Drag a block from the left list into a drop zone - it is inserted there
  • Drag a block in the document to another drop zone - it moves it
  • New order is automatically saved

7.7 Undo

The studio remembers up to 3 change steps:

  • After each save, the Undo button appears in the toolbar
  • Clicking Undo restores the previous state
  • Applies to text edits and order changes

7.8 Generating Documents

Test mode:

  1. Click on Test - fills all variables with sample data
  2. Document is generated immediately
  3. Download links for DOCX and PDF appear

Generate productively:

  1. Fill in all variables in the left column
  2. Enter reference (e.g., RV-2026-0042)
  3. Select format (DOCX, PDF, or both)
  4. Click on Generate
  5. Download links appear at the bottom left

7.10 Generation Log

All generated documents are recorded in the log:

  • Log tab shows all generated documents with date, template, and reference
  • DOCX and PDF can be downloaded directly
  • Filterable by time period (today, 7 days, 30 days)
